paragraphs: CSched sells scheduling services and software tools to public transit agencies, private operators, and school boards, whatever their size or mode of transportation. The company is the exclusive authorized reseller of GIRO's HASTUS software in North America.

Its scheduling and operations modules are built on the HASTUS platform. When an agency is short of schedulers, its Rent-a-Scheduler service supplies coverage from the short term to the long term. Training runs from foundational courses to advanced HASTUS workshops. Consulting work covers efficiency audits, labor negotiations, and tender bids. The firm also advises agencies adapting their scheduling practices for the shift to electric buses.

Transit agencies worldwide have relied on CSched since 2008. The site says more than 4,650 buses run every day on schedules developed with its software or services. CSched calls itself the only consulting firm fully dedicated to public transit scheduling. It operates globally with a strong presence in North America, serving agencies, school boards, and private operators. Its experts are described as bringing over 100 years of combined hands-on experience.

quote.text: As the only consulting firm fully dedicated to public transit scheduling, CSched understands scheduling better than any other company.
